description: Image Description: A single zebra is grazing in a lush, green grassy field under a partly cloudy sky. The zebra is positioned slightly off-center to the right, with its head lowered toward the ground as it feeds on the grass. Its black and white stripes are clearly visible, contrasting sharply with the vibrant green of the field. In the background, to the left, stands a solitary tree with a full canopy of green leaves, adding depth to the scene. The horizon line is relatively low
